verifications.question: Can `complete --check-only` pass while this stage's Until Loop receipt is still active (the Work line runs it inside the loop)?
verifications.evidence: shiploop_navigator.py `command == "complete"` branch: `loops.check_terminal` runs only `if ... and not check_only` (comment: 'It runs inside the stage's own loop, whose receipt is still active, so the receipt check waits for the real complete'); `_check_submitted_evidence(..., check_only=True)` skips the action's own receipt. Live: SP/11-step-plan.actions.md OUT 'ShipLoop check-only: every script gate for step-plan accepts this result (the Until Loop receipt is checked only on the real complete).' Caveat (kept, code text): that same success line says 'run the same complete command without --check-only to submit it', which inside an active loop is refused by check_loop_packet ('the step-plan loop is still active').

verifications.question: Can the template's six rewritten exit conditions coexist with the contract ShipLoop builds from stage_spec's seven done_when lines?
verifications.answer: no, not as two texts. The gate itself would still pass (the Contract file is written by `loops.contract_writes` from stage_spec and `check_terminal` rebuilds the same), but the print would contradict the contract the runtime echoes, and if an implementation writes the Contract file from the template while `check_terminal` keeps rebuilding from stage_spec, every step-plan done is refused ('the terminal packet is not from a run of this action's contract'). Only one source works.
verifications.evidence: python3: `loops.exit_condition('step-plan')` prints 7 numbered lines; the template argument has 6. `loops.REPEAT['step-plan']` ends 'a user's stop is the ShipLoop packet's pause command.'; the template's ends 'the packet's Pause command.' (string compare False). `loops.WORK['step-plan']` = 'Do duty items {items} of {run}/packets/{action}.md, writing the result at ...' with `_duty_items('step-plan','inline')` = '1-12'; the template Work is 'Plan work item {{item_id}} by the Method in {{packet_abs}} ...' and its Method has 9 inline items. `check_loop_packet` compares packet.work, conditions.exit, conditions.repeat and context with `contract()`. The runtime echoes the contract: SP/11-step-plan.actions.md OUT of `start` shows conditions.exit with the 7 stage_spec lines. Other readers of done_when: `_goal_lines` (active_improve parent packet), `loop_contract.stage_exit`, the Improve hand-off (SP/12-improve-step-plan.improve-handoff.md 'Done when (a done result must meet each ...)' lists the 7 lines), test/shiploop-head-order.test.py `tokens` (each done_when line is a P0 token).

verifications.question: Do the slots that depend on planned features render safely when absent?
verifications.answer: no for three of them, yes for D1
verifications.evidence: plan_concerns: no plan result can carry `concerns` (`navigator._RESULT_KEYS` lacks it) and a step-plan result that carries it is refused ('result has unsupported fields: concerns', ran `_canonical_result`). platform_testing: no card has a '## Testing' heading (`grep '^## ' skills/shiploop/references/platforms/*.md`: none); the proposal says a missing heading raises. platform_card: no code maps HOME/environment.md ## Targets and runtimes to a card (grep 'platforms/' in scripts: only prose); the Battleship section names 'Salesforce Developer Edition', not a card file; over=refuse. item_context: 'plan's gate refuses a context over this bound' is not true today (`_normalise_work_items` only `_text`s the context). In the filled packet the spent pool turned platform_testing into a pointer, which hides the missing heading. D1 tables of contents (spec_toc, arch_toc): a source exists today (`navigator._contents_lines`, the live 'Knowledge files this stage reads, listed by contents' block), so they render.

findings.where: Result form: '"concerns": [{"concern": "<row>", "steps": ["S1"], "check": "<command or case ID>"}]' with exit 5 and Method 8
findings.evidence: python3 `_canonical_result(live_result + concerns, stage='step-plan')` -> NavigatorError 'result has unsupported fields: concerns. Delete them ...'; `_RESULT_KEYS` has no concerns. Every done result that follows the form is refused, and the refusal ('delete them') contradicts exit condition 5, which the loop must satisfy.

findings.where: front matter slots platform_card ('over refuse'), platform_testing ('needs a ## Testing heading in each card'), item_context ('plan's gate refuses a context over this bound, so this slot never cuts')

A render that raises prints no packet: the run stalls. Not verified on a renderer (prototype tmpl.py not run).
findings.fix: platform_card: source a structured field (prepare result or environment.md line 'Platform card: GUIDES/platforms/<card>.md'), and when absent render 'Platform card: none recorded (cards: GUIDES/platforms/)'. platform_testing: print the line only under a flag `card_has_testing`. item_context: land the plan producer bound before this template, or make it `over: excerpt` with today's pointer '[Excerpt only. Full value: RUN/state.md; field work_items[<i>].context ...]'.

findings.where: Until Loop argument: 'Work: Plan work item {{item_id}} by the Method in {{packet_abs}} ...', exit lines 1-6, 'Repeat while ... the packet's Pause command.'
findings.evidence: `loops.exit_condition('step-plan')` = 7 stage_spec lines; REPEAT differs ('the ShipLoop packet's pause command'); WORK says 'Do duty items 1-12'. `check_loop_packet` compares work, exit, repeat and context with `contract()` rebuilt from stage_spec. The runtime echoes the 7-line contract (SP/11-step-plan.actions.md, `start` OUT); the Improve hand-off quotes the same 7 lines (SP/12-improve-step-plan.improve-handoff.md). P0 if the Contract file is written from the template text while check_terminal keeps rebuilding from stage_spec.
findings.fix: Replace the literal argument with one slot `{{loop_argument}}` rendered from `loops.contract(root, state, action)` (Work, exit_condition, repeat_condition, Contract, Receipt). Move the six conditions into stage_spec 'step-plan' done_when, the template Work into WORK['step-plan'] and the template Repeat into REPEAT['step-plan'], and have `_duty_items` count the template's Method items, so the packet, the contract, the Improve hand-off and the head-order tokens read one text.

Today's duty 5 and Checked by stated it; the live model read `_normalise_criteria` in navigator source (SP/11-step-plan.actions.md read_file shiploop_navigator.py at 2280-2330).

verdict.summary: The template fixes the live run's worst input gap: the whole work item context, symbols up front, and the two defect classes Improve found (criteria named on a command that never runs their code, source-text step checks). It cannot ship as drafted. Its result form carries `concerns`, which `_canonical_result` refuses today. Three slots (platform card, card Testing section, item context bound) have no source or bound in today's state, and the validator's own rule raises on them. Its Until Loop argument is a second text beside `loops.contract()`: the runtime echoes seven stage_spec conditions while the packet prints six. Its placeholder sentence promises refusals the gates don't make. It drops the criterion-coverage and deps rules the gates do apply (the live model read `_normalise_criteria` to learn the first one). It also turns the gate-checked open assumption A8 into a pointer, and it is over its own 19,500 budget (worst case 21,204).
top_changes: One source for the loop argument: render the argument block from loops.contract() and move the six conditions, the Work and the Repeat into stage_spec/WORK/REPEAT, so the packet, the Contract file, check_terminal, the Improve hand-off and the head-order tokens agree (SP-3).

Gate every planned-feature slot behind a flag or land the feature first: drop `concerns` from the form, exit 5 and Method 8 until A1 is in _RESULT_KEYS and its gate; give platform_card, platform_testing and item_context an absent or over-bound rendering that prints instead of raising (SP-1, SP-2).

Make the frame's claim true and route-test it: restate criterion coverage (including the test_commands_na case) and deps-earlier, register every new form placeholder in the gates, and keep the open assumptions and the revisit lines non-pooled (SP-4, SP-5, SP-7, SP-8, SP-13).
